title_sq: Ne Astir, Prane Vila L, Buze Rruges Kryesore, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Perfekte!!
description_sq: Ne Astir, Prane Vila L, Buze Rruges Kryesore, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Perfekte. title_en: In Astir, near Vila L, on the edge of the main street, 1+1 apartment for sale with a perfect layout!!
description_en: In Astir, near Vila L, on the edge of the main road, 1+1 apartment with perfect floor plan for sale. The apartment is located on the first residential floor of a well-managed building with an elevator from 2017, with a total area of ​​75 m2 and a net area of ​​64.8 m2 and is organized by a corridor that divides the living room with a kitchenette, a master bedroom with access to the balcony and a toilet. It is oriented towards the West. The area in which the apartment is located is very preferred for residence and investment as it offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, such as urban transport, supermarkets, bars, pharmacies, etc.
